verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy. The 3-line headline and the oversized Shop Flavours pill both fight to be the focal point, the subcopy floats above the CTA away from the headline, and the flavour chips are out of their original order with Blood Orange left alone on a ragged second row. The chips and legal text also sit cramped against the peach circle, so it reads as a different design. B keeps the original layout, which suits a canvas only a little taller, with clear hierarchy, aligned chips and the brand intact. Its flaws are minor: the yellow circle has grown oversized behind the logo and headline, there is extra empty space at top and bottom, and the legal line is still unreadably tiny.
